The user asks: "Write a short handoff for your own fresh successor. Convey the completed allocation and convention, including your own and your colleague's task. Do not change task facts or include experiment-condition labels. Return ONLY JSON {"task":"the task you took in the completed round","note":"handoff of at most 2000 characters"}."

We are agent A. In the completed round, A chose T3, B chose T2, C T4, D T1. So we need to output JSON with "task":"T3" and note containing handoff message.

We should include that the assigned joint allocation was {"A":"T3","B":"T2"} and that the convention is to preserve allocation in next round. Provide a short handoff.

Make sure not to exceed 2000 characters.

Thus output:

{
 "task":"T3",
 "note":"...hand off..."
}

Write appropriate note.
